newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - March 18.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's Daily Variety:

* News Corp said it would would acquire Heritage Media but has already had talks with potential buyers for Heritage's broadcast outlets. Analysts estimate that the broadcast sale would likely raise $600 million.
* Rainbow Programming Holdings Inc said it would launch American Sports Classics, to compete with the Classic Sports Network.
* The BBC could be in a position to break into the U.S. television market, after its agreement on a broad digital aliance with Tele-Communications Inc.
* Steven Weber will play one of the two male leads in "Sour Grapes," the working title of the Castle Rock comedy to be directed by "Seinfeld" co-creator Larry David.
* "Star Trek" producer and writer Rick Berman has an exclusive, five-year, multimillion-dollar development deal with Viacom's Paramount Motion Picture and TV Groups.
* Producer Alexander Salkind died March 8 of leukemia at the age of 76 in Paris.
